Haircare & GLOWWA

A little care.
Every day.

Personal product advice, a routine that suits you and care that continues beyond the salon.

Why do the right
products matter?

Your home routine is part of caring for your cut, colour and extensions. Thoughtfully chosen products help you look after the result long after your appointment.

01

A formula that suits your hair

The best choice starts with your hair type, scalp, colour and styling routine. Pippin can explain which ingredients and formulas suit your needs, rather than choosing by price or a label alone.

02

Care when you style

An appropriate heat protectant and considered styling technique help you look after your hair when using heated tools. Colour-care products can help maintain your finish between appointments.

03

Moisture & scalp comfort

Choose cleansing, conditioning and treatment products that suit your scalp and the lengths of your hair. The aim is a balanced routine that leaves your hair comfortable and manageable.

04

A finish you can enjoy

The right styling products can help with softness, shine, frizz control and hold. We’ll talk through how much to use and how to apply it, so you can recreate your finish at home.

05

Make your products work for you

Using the recommended amount and choosing products you actually need can make your routine simpler. Professional advice helps you get the most from each step.

06

Extra care for extensions & treated hair

Extensions, colour and other technical services need suitable aftercare. Follow the guidance for your particular method or treatment to look after the colour, bonds and finish.

Recommended by Pippin

Discover the
GLOWWA difference.

Hair care includes the everyday choices you make, from your salon routine to a varied, balanced diet.

I only recommend products I believe in. GLOWWA is a brand I use and trust, and one I recommend as part of a personal conversation about your hair care.

Pippin x

GLOWWA’s range includes daily hair supplements and collagen products. Pippin can talk you through the options, ingredients and manufacturer’s guidance, alongside the professional products you use on your hair.

The original formula

HAIR FOOD™

A daily supplement containing nutrients including biotin, zinc and vitamin C, alongside MSM and amino acids. Biotin and zinc contribute to the maintenance of normal hair.

A different life stage

HAIR FOOD | MENO™

A formula designed for women before, during and after menopause. Ask Pippin about the range and check the ingredients and manufacturer’s suitability guidance.

Explore the range

COLLAGEN

GLOWWA also offers collagen supplements. Ask about the current options, ingredients and how they are intended to be used.

Food supplements complement a varied, balanced diet and healthy lifestyle. Follow the product directions and seek advice from a qualified health professional if you are unsure about suitability, including during pregnancy or when taking medication.
